subject_definitions:

<Subject 1> is Jinhsi. Her human appearance strictly follows Image2: a young adult woman with straight silver-white bangs, long silver-white hair tied on both sides, pale blue-gray eyes, golden horn-shaped hair ornaments, and teal ribbons. She wears a silver-gray high-collared inner garment and layered pale teal-and-white robes with dark teal, gold-trimmed cuffs and borders. Her accessories include pearl necklaces, blue gemstone pendants, and waist tassels. She wears pale teal-gray ankle boots. Preserve the face, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing construction, and accessories shown in the reference. During human-form combat, she holds one silver longsword in her RIGHT hand and forms magical seals with her LEFT hand. The sword is an additional combat prop.

Jinhsi's complete dragon form strictly follows the dragon in Image4: a wingless Chinese dragon approximately two hundred meters long, with a slender, serpentine body, deep black scales, interlocking black and dark-gold armor plates on its head, backward-extending branching horns, glowing golden markings, a silver-white mane and long whiskers, and four clawed limbs. White-gold energy gathers deep inside its mouth, allowing it to release powerful golden dragon breath. Jinhsi's human and dragon appearances are two forms of the same individual. Her body, clothing, accessories, and sword all participate in the same transformation.

<Subject 2> is Changli. Her human appearance strictly follows Image1: a young adult woman with golden-brown eyes, long hair transitioning from rose red to pale pink, an upper tied section secured with a black bow, and layered loose strands framing her face. She wears a white overlapping long dress, a gray-black semi-transparent high-collared inner layer, and a deep-red, wide-sleeved outer robe draped around her shoulders and arms. The red robe features golden embroidery. Her accessories include layered pearl necklaces, golden ornaments, and waist tassels. She wears black lace-up tall boots. Preserve the feminine face, hairstyle, body proportions, and red-and-white clothing shown in the reference.

Changli's complete phoenix form strictly follows Image3: an enormous fire phoenix with a wingspan of approximately three hundred meters, a brilliant white-gold chest and abdomen, an orange-gold elongated neck and phoenix head, a sharp curved beak, glowing eyes, and backward-sweeping flame crest feathers. Both wings consist of clearly layered long feathers, golden-orange near the body and gradually transitioning to crimson and dark red-black toward the outer edges. Several long, curved, burning red-and-gold tail feathers trail behind it. Flames flow along the feather edges, while sparks and burning feather fragments drift around the body. Preserve a clearly defined avian skeletal structure, phoenix head, two wings, two talons, and long tail feathers.

Changli's human and fire-phoenix forms are the same individual. Her entire body, hair, clothing, and accessories continuously transform into the phoenix, without a separate rider or another Changli. During her final defense, she draws the phoenix's entire body, wings, and tail feathers inward into an immense flame form approximately three hundred meters across, with the flaming phoenix projecting fire.

<Subject 3> is the dark rocky canyon battlefield shown in Image4: steep rock walls, fractured rocky terraces, dark boulders, layered distant mountains, heavy smoke clouds, drifting dust, and orange-gold firelight. Cool gray ambient light illuminates the rock faces, while the phoenix's flames and golden dragon breath provide intense localized illumination. Nearby rocky ridges thirty to fifty meters high remain visible as persistent scale references.

reference_use:

Image1 defines only Changli's human identity, hairstyle, clothing, and accessories.
Image2 defines only Jinhsi's human identity, hairstyle, clothing, and accessories.
The different views within each character reference depict the same individual. Do not generate multiple characters or inherit the studio backgrounds or presentation layouts.

Image3 defines only Changli's fire-phoenix appearance, feather structure, flame colors, and long tail feathers. Do not inherit its static background or illustration brushwork.

Image4 defines Jinhsi's black-and-gold dragon appearance, the rocky canyon environment, the battle lighting and colors, and the final diagonal attack composition. Do not generate its additional floating human figure or inherit its illustration brushwork.

summary:

[reference generation] A 16:9 live-action fantasy feature-film battle following the original twenty-second narrative structure. Jinhsi descends from the sky and confronts Changli. Changli challenges her verbally, then transforms her own body into an enormous fire phoenix. A powerful wing strike shatters Jinhsi's golden defensive shield and throws her into a rock wall. Injured, Jinhsi forms a magical seal at the mountain base. Her body, clothing, and sword transform together into a black-and-gold dragon, and the pressure of her transformation ruptures the ground. She ascends, hovers, and releases golden dragon breath toward Changli. Changli draws her complete phoenix body inward into an immense defensive flame form. The sequence ends on a frozen image of golden dragon breath colliding with orange-red flames.

dialogue:

The two lines form an exchange between Changli and Jinhsi.

While still in human form, Changli looks directly at Jinhsi and speaks with an intimidating presence:
<d>[Chinese] 今汐，坐上令尹之位后，是疏于修炼了？</d>

After being thrown into the rock wall, Jinhsi responds with a different female voice and a taunting tone:
<d>[Chinese] ......师傅，让您看看我的修炼成果吧！</d>

Human-form dialogue has accurate lip synchronization. Phoenix-form dialogue is clearly emitted from the phoenix's head, with subtle beak movements following the words and no human lips. Both lines remain complete and intelligible.

detailed_description:

Photorealistic live-action fantasy with feature-film quality. Render realistic skin, hair, silk, embroidery, metal, stone, scales, and feathers. Fire and energy effects have visible volume, occlusion, contact, and environmental interaction. Jinhsi occupies the left side of the main compositions, while Changli occupies the right. Maintain the same battle axis and eyeline directions after their transformations. Actions continue across cuts. Injuries, rubble, frost, scorch marks, and smoke accumulate throughout the sequence.

[Shot 1]
A ground-level, low-angle wide shot. Jinhsi descends abruptly from the upper left and stops in a hover approximately five centimeters above the rocky ground. Her pale teal-and-white robe hems and silver-white hair continue downward through inertia before swinging back. Compressed air pushes dust outward around her feet.

Changli stands farther away on the right. The airflow moves her red outer robe and pink-red hair. She raises her eyes toward Jinhsi and slowly steadies her stance. The mountain base on the left, a central rocky ridge, and boulders on the right establish the characters' positions.

[Shot 2]
Cut to a waist-up three-quarter view of Changli as the camera slowly pushes closer. Facing Jinhsi on the left, she lifts her chin slightly and fixes her golden-brown eyes on her opponent. She raises her right hand to her chest, with small sparks appearing between her fingers.

Changli speaks in clear, commanding female Mandarin with synchronized lip movement:
<d>[Chinese] 今汐，坐上令尹之位后，是疏于修炼了？</d>

In the left background, Jinhsi raises the longsword in her RIGHT hand and points its tip toward Changli, while her LEFT hand prepares a magical seal. After Changli finishes speaking, the flames between her fingers abruptly expand, leading into her transformation.

[Shot 3]
Cut to a distant wide view retaining both characters and the rocky ridge. Flames rise around Changli's feet and spread upward along her red robe, hair, and arms. She opens both arms. Her body, clothing, and accessories transform together into one continuously expanding mass of red-and-gold fire.

Inside that same fire, her torso develops into the phoenix's chest and abdomen. Her neck lengthens into the phoenix's head and neck. Her arms extend outward into enormous wings, her legs become two avian talons, and her long hair and trailing robe sections merge into multiple burning tail feathers. Feathers form in successive layers. The chest and abdomen become white-gold, the wing roots become golden-orange, and the outer flight feathers become crimson and dark red-black. The completed appearance matches Image3.

The phoenix spreads its wings to approximately three hundred meters and hovers above the right side of the canyon. Jinhsi becomes a tiny pale teal-and-white figure beside the ridge on the left. The phoenix casts a vast moving shadow, and fire along its feather edges illuminates the rock walls. Its first powerful wingbeat drives dust and loose stones outward below.

[Shot 4]
Cut to a rising three-quarter tracking shot. Jinhsi's body, clothing, and RIGHT-hand sword transform together into a white-blue stream of ice, accelerating along an arc from the lower left toward the upper right and the phoenix's chest.

Changli, in phoenix form, tightens her body and rotates her chest and shoulder girdle. She draws the enormous wing closest to Jinhsi backward, then sweeps it forcefully forward. The solid leading edge of the wing intercepts the ice stream's flight path.

Jinhsi's ice stream spreads into a broad golden shield in front of the wing. Show the entire collision continuously: the wing's leading edge strikes the shield's center, the golden shield's main structural ribs bend inward, and cracks spread along six crystalline branches. The wing strike continues forward and completely shatters the golden shield. Flames roll through the broken shield fragments as steam and shield debris burst outward together.

Jinhsi's human body and RIGHT-hand sword re-form behind the shield. The transmitted impact throws her toward the rock wall on the left. Her body, hair, and robe hems travel in the same direction.

[Shot 5]
Cut on Jinhsi's continuing backward flight, with the camera tracking her from the side. Her back and shoulder strike the rock wall. The stone fractures at the contact point, fragments burst outward, and dense dust billows around her.

She slides down to the mountain base, still holding her sword in her RIGHT hand. Her silver-white hair, pale teal-and-white robe hems, and tassels trail with the fall. Preserve the impact fracture and scattered rubble in all subsequent shots.

[Shot 6]
A low-angle view of the phoenix's head and chest high above the right side of the canyon. Its orange-gold neck bends toward the lower left, and its glowing eyes fix on Jinhsi's impact site. The dark-red wings slowly spread behind it, while burning tail feathers curl through the smoke clouds.

Jinhsi responds in a female Mandarin voice:
<d>[Chinese] 师傅，让您看看我的修炼成果吧！</d>

The voice is clearly emitted from Changli's phoenix form, and the beak opens and closes subtly with the words. As the laughter ends, cut back to the dust at the mountain base.

[Shot 7]
The dust gradually clears. Jinhsi kneels on one knee beneath the damaged rock wall, with a small trace of blood at the corner of her mouth. Her RIGHT hand uses the sword to support her body, while her LEFT hand forms a magical seal. She raises her eyes toward the phoenix above. Frost spreads from the ground to her robe hems, skin, and sword.

She pulls the sword free. Her body, silver-white hair, ornaments, robes, and sword simultaneously dissolve into one continuously expanding mass of white-blue cold vapor. The camera keeps pulling back without cutting away to conceal the transformation. Her human silhouette disappears within the same vapor, where a vast serpentine body gradually develops.

Her head elongates into a dragon head with branching horns. Her torso continues lengthening, four clawed limbs form, and a long tail extends above the ground. The vapor condenses into the deep-black scales, dark-gold head armor, glowing golden markings, silver-white mane, and long whiskers shown in Image4. White-gold light gradually appears deep inside the dragon's mouth.

Pressure from the growing dragon first lifts a slab away from the center, then tears a diagonal fracture along a natural rock joint. The fracture bends and branches with uneven width. Some branches stop, while others develop into offset cavities. Rocks on one side collapse inward, while blocks on the opposite side rise unevenly. Cold vapor escapes from different gaps at staggered moments as stone slabs tilt, break, and fall.

After the transformation completes, Jinhsi's entire dragon body levitates. A clear open gap appears between her belly and the ground. All four claws tuck inward, and the long tail lifts completely away from the ground. No separate human Jinhsi or sword remains.

[Shot 8]
A side tracking shot. The black-and-gold dragon raises her head, releases a prolonged roar, and climbs along a steep upward curve. Her slender body and tail follow her head in sequence, while her silver-white mane streams backward. All four limbs remain tucked, and continuous serpentine motion carries her upward.

Jinhsi slows into a hover approximately two hundred meters above the canyon floor. She remains on the left, several hundred meters from the phoenix on the right. Slow waves pass through her body and tail to stabilize her airborne position. She lowers her head toward the lower right and opens her jaws. White-gold energy gathers deep in her throat, illuminating her teeth, black-and-gold armor plates, and silver-white whiskers.

Seeing the dragon breath charging, Changli folds her wings inward, draws her talons close to her abdomen, and coils her long tail feathers toward the center of her body. Her head, neck, chest, abdomen, wings, talons, and all tail feathers continuously transform into burning flames. She also releases a flame stream to clash directly with the dragon's breath.

The fireball occupies the phoenix's previous position and measures approximately three hundred meters across. Dense orange-red flames roll over its surface, a white-gold high-temperature core flashes within, and dark-red burning feather fragments swirl around its exterior. The phoenix's entire body has entered this flame form.

[Shot 9]
Cut to a wide aerial three-quarter view, following the diagonal attack direction in Image4. The black-and-gold dragon occupies the upper left, the immense orange-red fireball occupies the lower right, and the dark rocky canyon extends far below.

Jinhsi maintains her airborne position and exhales a continuous, powerful stream of golden energy. The beam has a white-gold core and golden-yellow outer edges, crossing diagonally from the upper left to the lower right. Its core is bright and dense, while golden flame trails and tiny luminous particles tear away from its edges. Keep a clearly visible stretch of open air between the dragon's mouth and the fireball.

The dragon breath strikes the side of the fireball facing the dragon. The flames at the contact point develop a visible inward depression and curl outward around it. Golden energy and orange-red molten fire continuously press against each other, releasing bright sparks, incandescent fragments, and irregular waves of smoke. The impact light illuminates nearby rock walls and drifting dust. Changli's flame stream trembles and deforms under the pressure while maintaining its complete defensive form.

Freeze the entire image for the final half-second: the black-and-gold dragon hovering in the upper left, the immense orange-red flames in the lower right, and the golden dragon breath crossing diagonally through the frame and continuously pressing into the flame surface. The contact point is the brightest area, while the dragon's head, silver-white mane, and fireball silhouette remain clearly visible.

overall_soundscape:

Canyon wind and small falling stones continue throughout the scene. Changli's phoenix transformation includes rising flames, spreading wings, and a deep phoenix cry. The wing strike produces heavy air pressure, the golden shield shatters with crisp crystalline cracking, and the mountainside impact combines exploding stone with a low-frequency collision.

Jinhsi's dragon transformation includes rushing cold air, condensing scales, staggered stone fractures, and grinding rock slabs. After she ascends, use a deep dragon roar and high-altitude wind. The golden dragon breath produces a sustained energy-jet sound, while the fireball's rolling flames and impact explosions change with distance and camera position.

The first line uses Changli's female voice. Music and combat effects recede beneath the dialogue. The second line uses Jinhsi's female voice. No additional narration.

non_diegetic_music:

Low strings and deep percussion intensify during Changli's phoenix transformation and recede beneath dialogue. Rapid strings and brass enter as Jinhsi transforms into the dragon and ascends. A powerful sustained low chord accompanies the dragon breath striking the fireball. The music stops abruptly with the final frozen image.

continuity_constraints:

There are only two fighters throughout the sequence: Jinhsi and Changli. Human Jinhsi is bound to Image2, human Changli to Image1, Changli's phoenix form to Image3, and Jinhsi's dragon form to Image4.

Human and divine-beast forms transform continuously into one another. Do not create simultaneous human-and-beast duplicates, riders, or additional floating characters. The phoenix retains its head, two wings, two talons, and burning long tail feathers. The dragon retains its black-and-gold scales, silver-white mane, four clawed limbs, and wingless structure.

Maintain the same canyon, battle axis, and progressively accumulated rock-wall damage, rubble, frost, scorch marks, and smoke. No subtitles or watermarks.
